name: auryn-docker
summary: Dockerfile plugin for Auryn and the first producer of the deployment & infrastructure tier (ADR 0007). A dependency-free Dockerfile parser emits BuildStage nodes, the shared image-keyed `Image` hub (the FROM chain, as resolved:false placeholders) and multi-stage COPY --from edges; a `deploy` enrichment links build stages to the code they package (PACKAGES), recomputes image `resolved` and GCs orphan images. Compose/k8s/Helm/Terraform producers join onto the hub. Depends only on auryn-core.
